title: Third Shot Drop Choice (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance fusion 134bpm heavy bongo conga djembe slap bass spanish guitar pads synth lead trance buildup tribal claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Fifth ball comes deep
Returner pushes back the line
Server in the transition zone
Drop the ball into the kitchen

[Verse 1]
Return deep to the back third
Server in the transition heard
Third shot drop is the choice
Arc the ball gentle voice
Vamos vamos drop the ball
Uno dos tres soft and small
Land inside the kitchen line
Let them lift the ball fine

[Pre-Chorus]
Drop drop drop
Arc and slow
Drop drop drop
Low and flow

[Chorus]
Third shot drop choice third shot drop choice
Arc and slow arc and slow
Third shot drop choice third shot drop choice
Vamos amigos let it flow

[Verse 2 coaching]
Why drop and not drive
Because drive at the line they thrive
The drop forces them to lift
Gives time for forward shift
Uno dos tres four steps in
Mano blanda before they spin
Apex above the tape soft
Landing low in the kitchen loft

[Bridge]
Drop is high percentage shot
Drive only when the angle is hot
When receiver is at the kitchen
Drop is the smart pitching

[Chorus]
Third shot drop choice third shot drop choice
Arc and slow arc and slow
Third shot drop choice third shot drop choice
Vamos amigos let it flow

[Outro]
Drop drop drop
Arc and slow
Four steps in
Let it flow
